description: This is a unit test class for DeleteFeatureStrategy, testing its behavior in deleting features from a Thing object within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureStrategyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the DeleteFeatureStrategy's functionality and immutability.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Sets up the static 'featureId' used in test cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes an instance of DeleteFeatureStrategy before each test.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteFeatureFromThing
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of a feature from a Thing object.

methods.name: deleteFeatureFromThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Tests error when attempting to delete a feature from a Thing that has no features.
